## Description
&#10;&#9;&#9;H₃PO₄ is phosphoric acid (also called orthophosphoric acid) — an inorganic mineral acid&#10;&#9;&#9;with a molar mass of 97.99 g/mol. Melting point&#9;42 °C (108 °F). &#10;&#9;&#9;Colorless crystalline solid (pure); colorless viscous syrup (85% aq.).&#10;&#9;&#9;On Earth, ~90% of H₃PO₄ production goes to phosphate fertilizers (DAP, MAP, TSP).
